overall_assessment: Anonymization works well for NLA. No personal data is left in the 12 courses (read in full, including the truncated reading lists, from plans recomputed with the current R/anonymize.R), nor in a scan of all 249 NLA plans: no e-mails, phone numbers, staff names, contact blocks, approval stamps, semester-year labels or academic years. The only removals are the header values 'Undervisningssemester: Vår/Høst' (or 'Oppstart høst,') and 'Studieår: 2019 — 2020', and the em-dash year is now dropped in all 249 plans. All 4 suspects are false alarms from reference content: a date in a vatican.va URL (phone), publication dates such as 'Vårt Land 19. januar 1994' and 'Nobelforedrag 11. september 1979' (admin_date), and Augusto Boal and Emmanuel Levinas named in an article title (name_like). Film running times ('Lengde: 2:19') are kept since #308. One cosmetic issue lies outside the packet: in 4 PE103 plans, 'Høst 2024:' and 'Vår 2025:' were exam-part labels under 'Avsluttende vurdering', and removing them leaves bare ':' lines.
